The '''Cork Bobber''' is a [[tackle]] that helps [[fishing]] by increasing the [[Fishing#Bar Size|fishing bar size]] by 24 pixels (48 pixels if the player is using an [[Advanced Iridium Rod]] with 2 Cork Bobbers).<ref name="bobberbar" /> It can be [[Crafting|crafted]] or purchased from [[Fish Shop|Willy's Fish Shop]] for {{Price|750}} after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 7]]. It may also randomly appear at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|250}}. It can also be found in [[Mystery Box]]es and [[Golden Mystery Box]]es after reaching Fishing level 6.
